spec.requirement: Implement pilot/normalize.py with normalize_counts(values). Accept a list of built-in ints only (type(x) is int, reject bool). Reject non-list or non-int values with TypeError and negative ints with ValueError. Return a new dictionary count=len(values), total=sum(values), maximum=max(values) or zero for empty. Do not mutate the input. Use Python standard library only, with no filesystem/network operations in normalize_counts. Create pilot/verify.py using unittest. Cover empty input, zero, multiple values, bool, float, string, negative, non-list input, immutability and distinct dictionaries. The exact validation command must run tests and fail nonzero on failure.
